What that looked like

Onboarding, documents,
then the invoice.

We watched a week of real work, then built the collection: onboarding, the KYC documents the matter needed, a draft invoice. The lawyer kept invoicing and the last message to the client. 80% fewer manual hours in that engagement — founder-reported, not a forecast for you, and not full AML.
